stem: Source-water EC is noticeably higher than its established baseline before fertilizer is added. What should be done first?
choices: Reduce irrigation frequency first because a higher source-water EC indicates the crop is taking up water too slowly
Increase fertilizer concentration so the final solution preserves the same ratio between source EC and fertilizer EC
Confirm the source-water measurement and compare the source with prior records before changing the nutrient program
Adjust final-solution pH first because a higher source EC is best corrected by returning pH to the previous target
rationale: A source-water EC change can alter the starting ionic load. The strongest first step is to verify the measurement and source change before modifying the nutrient program.
